description:
Compare direct vs indirect associations for a target or disease and save to parquet file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table association_overall_direct — one record = one direct target-disease association score over all evidence.
Key: diseaseId, targetId.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); disease_id accepts ot disease or disease name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by score desc, then diseaseId asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.target` counts targets; `_vbt.grains.disease` counts diseases.
Rows with unknown score are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Direct OT 25.09 associations (evidence on the disease itself); absence means no evidence, not a negative finding.
Counts are over the complete direct and indirect key sets; limit bounds only the rows listed per part. No file is written (output_path is accepted and confined, nothing is saved to it).

schema.description: Pass at least one of: target_id, disease_id.

disease_id.description: Accepts ot_disease, disease_name; resolved to one ot_disease (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

min_score.description: Keeps rows with score >= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.0; pass null for no restriction.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
